title: the picture of the layers names the code that implements it, and the check follows every name
intent: The wave D2a of the track D: the picture of the layers of the core is drawn in the notation of components instead of in ASCII.  The source is new (`site/diagrams/core-layers.puml', 69 lines) and the check of it is new (`tests/checks/check-the-layer-diagram-points-at-files-that-exist.el', 247 lines).  The wave touches no code of the kernel.  The picture is the same picture that the ASCII figure of the site shows (`site/index.html:482-506') and that `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:501-523' describes: the drivers (Human, ACP clients, MCP clients, Batch, Wire) submit to the Session API and the Run Controller, the controller drives the model adapter, the tool registry and the policy, the scheduler runs what may run, everything that happened is written into one append-only JSONL journal, and the projections read the journal.  The picture has four packages -- the drivers, the core, the journal and the projections -- and 15 blocks; every block names the files of `lib/' that implement it, by `file:line', and 64 such names are there (the snapshot of wave 97).  **The source is written by hand and not by the code**: `docs/SITE-DIAGRAMS-PLAN.md:277-280' names only the diagram of the state machine as generated out of the code, and the other diagrams are written by hand with the names of the modules and the lines they are at.  **The check measures four things**: (1) every reference of the form `file:line' points at a file of the repository, at a line of that file and at a line that carries a definition -- a path that leaves the repository is refused, and a line that is empty, that holds nothing but a comment, or that holds code and no definition is refused; (2) every module of `lib/' is named by the picture or listed in the note of the modules the picture does not name, with the reason why it is not there -- a module that is nowhere is a module the picture dropped silently; (3) the note names no module that is not there, names no module without a reason and names no module that the picture names as well; (4) every block of the picture names at least one file and the four layers of the picture are there.  **The parent strengthened the check of the writer on 2026-11-21**: the check of the writer held a reference to a line that carries code, and the body of a function carries code, so a wave that moves a line of the kernel leaves the picture pointing at the wrong place and the check says nothing; the reference must name a definition now, and the control that broke this hole was measured before the fix and did not fall, and it falls after it.  **Two contradictions of two sources are recorded and not resolved silently**: (a) the reconnaissance of the parent said that the check of the render of the diagrams draws every `.puml' of the repository -- the writer measured that it does not: the check builds fixture trees of its own (`probe.puml', `alpha.puml', `beta.puml') and draws those, so nothing in the gate draws the new picture, and the writer proved the render of the picture by a direct run of `scripts/dev diagrams' in a copy of the tree (the code 0, and the code 1 on a picture with a broken quote); (b) the briefing of the parent named three packages, and the writer made four -- the picture of the site has a journal layer between the scheduler and the projections, and the writer followed the picture and not the briefing.
objection: The claim is about the names of the picture and not about the picture itself.  The price is named and it is five prices.  (a) **The sense of the layout is a judgment and not a measurement**: the check holds that every name of the picture is a file of the repository, a line of that file and a definition on that line; it does not hold that the block `Tool registry' is the block that the registry belongs to, and the writer says so in his report.  (b) **The arrows are not measured at all**: the check does not read them and does not hold that they lead where they must lead.  (c) **Nothing in the gate draws the picture**: the check of the render of the diagrams draws the trees of its own fixtures, so the render of this picture is proved by a run of the pipeline that the writer made by hand and that the record of the wave names; the check that holds the picture of the site is the wave D4, and it does not exist yet.  (d) **The picture is not in the site yet**: the insertion into `site/index.html' and the style are the wave D3, and the wave 97 does not touch them.  (e) **The claim is not amended and not rewritten**: the claim `the-layer-diagram-points-at-files-that-exist' is new in this wave, and the strengthening of the parent is in the check and in the text of the claim, not in a second promise.  (f) **The check measures the names and not the truth of the names**: a line that carries a definition is a definition of something, and the something is the judgment of the writer; the wave does not pretend otherwise.
refuted_by: the diagram names a file, a line or a module that is not there, or it drops a module of `lib/' silently: a reference to a file that does not exist, a reference to a line the file does not have, a reference to a line that carries no definition, a reference to a path that leaves the repository, a module of `lib/' that the diagram neither names nor lists in its note, a module that the note names without a reason, a module that the note names and the diagram names as well, a block of the picture that names no file, or a package of the picture that is not there, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The wave drew the picture of the layers of the core and touched no code of the kernel.  (1) **The picture**: `site/diagrams/core-layers.puml', 69 lines, four packages and 15 blocks, 64 names of the form `file:line' (65 after wave 98 re-anchored the picture -- the snapshot of wave 98), 17 arrows of the solid kind and 2 of the dashed kind; every name points at a definition of the kernel -- on the snapshot of wave 97: 52 `defun', 5 `defconst', 5 `cl-defun' and 2 `cl-defstruct'.  (2) **The completeness**: `lib/' holds 66 modules (the snapshot of wave 97); 64 are named by the picture and 2 are in the note of the modules the picture does not name, with the reason (67 modules, 65 named and 2 excluded after wave 98 added `lib/yeah-risk.el' -- the snapshot of wave 98) -- `lib/yeah-codes.el' is experimental and is not wired into the loop of the agent, and `lib/yeah-state-diagram.el' is the generator of the state diagram, a tool of the author and not a component of the harness at run time.  (3) **The check**: `tests/checks/check-the-layer-diagram-points-at-files-that-exist.el', 247 lines as the writer left it and 251 after the parent strengthened it; the exit codes are 0 (the names are there), 1 (a name is not there) and 2 (the tree is not where the check thinks it is).  (4) **The parent strengthened the check on 2026-11-21**: a reference must name a definition and not merely a line with code, because the body of a function carries code; the control that broke this hole did not fall on the check of the writer (the code 0 on a picture that names the line 64 of `lib/yeah-context.el', which is the body of a `let') and falls on the check of the parent (the code 1 and the refusal `the diagram names lib/yeah-context.el:64, and that line carries no definition').  (5) **Eight controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-21**: four by the writer (the module `lib/yeah-trash.el' dropped from the picture -- the code 1; the reference `lib/yeah.el:37' put on a line that does not exist -- the code 1 and the refusal `the diagram names lib/yeah.el:99999, and the file has 81 line(s)'; a new module in `lib/' -- the code 1; the block `Wire' without a file -- the code 1) and four more by the parent (a reference on a line with code and no definition -- the code 0 before the strengthening and the code 1 after it; a block without a file -- the code 1; a module that the picture names and the note excludes -- the code 1; the honest tree -- the code 0).  (6) **Two contradictions of two sources are recorded**: the reconnaissance of the parent said that the check of the render draws every diagram of the repository, and the writer measured that it does not -- it draws the trees of its own fixtures, so nothing in the gate draws this picture; and the briefing of the parent named three packages while the picture of the site has a journal layer, so the writer made four and followed the picture.  (7) **What the wave did not measure**: the sense of the layout, the arrows, the insertion into the site (the wave D3) and the currency of the picture (the wave D4).
